entries.title: Arm on the cart (cart drawing 5 of 5)
items: Draft drawings of the SO-101 arm on the cart: joints A-F, board and cable path, reach to a D1 pick hole and a seedling cell, and the stowed pose for travel. Assumptions listed at the top of cad/cart_arm.py. Finding: with the 332 mm plate, the cart cannot go as low as the 550 mm shoulder in pod_store_reach (plate end would be inside the lid); drawn at 590 mm.

entries.title: Whole cart assembly v2
items: Base plate is now an open frame with large cut-outs; the arm mount moved to the middle of the plate. Battery narrowed and moved to fit.

entries.title: Control UI spike, Firebase, servo prices
items: Servo prices: Amazon UK STS3215 30 kg at £32.22 each (£193 for six) is over the £135 rule; a £23 ST3215 listing (£138 for six, voltage to confirm) is still just over. ArmDojo about £126 for six with VAT, before the board. Final check on the desktop, order on 11 Nov.
Roadmap: cart drawings added as next, before software.
Viber #45: whole-cart assembly drawing. First run failed (Python wheels committed, GitHub rejected the push); sent back with the fix.
Viber #46: find why the hub is slow to navigate, and whether a host move would help.
Decided: control UI = web page with a live MuJoCo sim (WebAssembly, in the browser) and a command panel, with a Sim/Real toggle over one command layer. Real drives the arm over Web Serial later.
Decided: host on a new Firebase project, pond-grow (pond-grow.web.app), with the sim as /sim inside the Pond hub. Viber #47 started the spike (arm only).
Command language note: motors, poses, cart, tasks (pick D3, place B5); layout numbers configurable.
Viber #48: task dependencies with an Awaiting stage (after ready / after live).

entries.title: CONTEXT.md and arm V1 build plan
items: Added docs/CONTEXT.md: the start point for every session, pointing to the roadmap, history and decisions instead of copying them.
Arm build starts in the UK, two months before Brazil.
Follower arm only, no leader: pod picking is structured enough for scripted moves.
No camera yet: the servos report their own angles.
Order: six 12 V STS3215 servos and one Waveshare board, from Amazon UK if under about £135, otherwise ArmDojo. No big UK shop stocks them.
Print ahead of the motors; weigh the current filament spool first.
After assembly: calibrate, teach poses, mock pick-and-place.
New roadmap item: arm dev tool, a web app over Web Serial built through Viber.
Water system moved to later.

entries.title: Whole cart assembly drawing
items: First of five cart drawings: the whole cart assembled (cad/cart_assembly.py), reusing the hand sleeve for both hands, in the gallery Cart section as a draft. Hand spacing, base plate, battery, motor and arm positions are placeholders marked ASSUMED.

entries.title: Project hub, move to GitHub, arm and printer
items: Gallery v2 merged (PR #9): categories, status chips, version history.
Arm V1: buy STS3215 servos and pay import tax; cost-cutting is a V2/V3 R&D track.
Printer: plain Bambu Lab A1, bought in Brazil (pending a chat with Mum).
Built the project hub: homepage, roadmap, shopping list, history (PR #10).
Moved the project from Google Drive to GitHub: decision docs and working notes now live in the repo, with a Decisions page (PR #11). Drive is an archive.
Phone fixes: no sideways scrolling, clickable roadmap cards, shopping totals (PR #12).
Burger menu shared by every page, and a page for each roadmap item (PR #13).
Homepage feature drawing of the unit; home-screen app that always loads the latest version (PR #14).
Shop links and arm decision card (PR #16); Pond added to Viber; clamp collar v3 (PR #18).

entries.title: Bracing, solar, flat-pack and charging dock
items: A-frame, back strut and top triangle on hinged clamp collars; no holes in the pipe.
Fold-out feet with bolts, pegs or sandbags.
One 30 W north-facing panel at 23°; a battery in the base and one on the cart. Only a water inlet needed.
Flat-pack check v3: everything fits in the 30 cm tank.
Charging dock v1: copper plates on the track's bottom run, spring brush pads on the cart.
First energy budget estimate.

entries.title: Unit v3 and CAD gallery
items: Unit v3: 30 cm tank, track top at 1.9 m, 33.7 mm tube spine, three-piece track sides.
Spine joint v1: spigot with anti-twist key, shock cord through the bore; water in a separate tube inside the spine.
Moved the working folder to Pond 2027.
Public CAD gallery built from renders.json (PR #8).
